name: pr-tracker
description: A pane tracking the GitHub PRs this session creates or works on: state, review, mergeability and CI progress via gh

requestsPerHour.title: GitHub requests per hour
requestsPerHour.description: The most gh requests the tracker makes in any hour, shared by every Claude session on this machine. Each request fetches every due PR at once.

daemonCommand.title: Daemon command
daemonCommand.description: A command that, when it answers `ping`, takes over fetching (`fetch` reads a request on stdin and prints the response). Empty to always use the built-in coordinator.
